data.reportText: Micron Technology, Inc. Common Stock is expected* to report earnings on  09/30/2026 after market close.  The report will be for the fiscal Quarter ending Aug 2026.  According to Zacks Investment Research, based on  10 analysts'  forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $31.24.  The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was $2.86.
